export_notebooks_to_markdown: export all IPython notebooks in a directory to markdown files using nbconvert
convert_notebook_to_markdown: convert a single Jupyter notebook file to a markdown document with embedded outputs
generate_tutorial_docs: generate tutorial markdown documentation from in-repo Jupyter notebooks for a project
save_notebook_images: save output images from Jupyter notebooks to the specified output directory during export
batch_export_notebooks: batch export multiple notebooks from a directory to a separate output folder as markdown
